mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rss_item (feed_id, link, title, summary, published_at) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{link}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{publishedAt}) ON CONFLICT (feed_id, link) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.feed_id, f.title AS feed_title, f.site_url, i.title, i.link, i.summary, i.published_at, i.created_at FROM rss_item i JOIN rss_feed f ON f.id = i.feed_id AND f.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY i.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rss_item i JOIN rss_feed f ON f.id = i.feed_id AND f.enabled = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rss_item WHERE feed_id = #{feedId}
